_doc: The design-delta engine's config, read from the project root. Contracts live beside their components; the design side is Figma with no files yet, so `verify` runs contract-to-code only until a snapshot is gathered.

rules._doc: Severities that differ from the engine defaults. coverage/uncontracted-component is error here because CLAUDE.md invariant 2 makes the contract the source of truth: a component with no contract is never audited again, which is the drift this template exists to prevent. Pinned by test-utils/contract-coverage.test.ts. tokens/token-unreferenced ignores the primitive tier, which scopes tokens/token-unemitted too; why is README § Tokens.

exemptions._doc: Semantic tokens no example component uses yet, kept on purpose; why, and when to delete an entry, is README § Tokens.

tokens/token-unreferenced.reason: Template headroom: the semantic layer ships whole, for the next component (README § Tokens).
